description: The Economics of Solar Power in Canada is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Canada Energy Regulator | La Régie de l’énergie du Canada. This dataset contains estimates of power generation and economic breakevens for solar-power projects at various scales and installation costs in most communities in Canada. Coverage: Canada. The portal files it under the publisher Canada Energy Regulator | La Régie de l’énergie du Canada. Its tags are REC, Énergie solaire, électricité renouvelable, électricité, énergies renouvelables. It offers 4 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2024-02-24 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Canada (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
